title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Cheran brings Pallavan home, and Nila makes them promise never to leave home. Overwhelmed with emotion, Cheran expresses his deep affection for Pallavan.

title: Connect Link Pannu Win Pannu
description: Kureishi hosts Cooku with Comali stars in the last episode as two teams compete in exciting clue-guessing rounds and select ATMs for the ultimate cash prize.

title: Neeya Naana
description: Gopinath hosts a vibrant debate on green vs. red flag attitudes with youngsters. Guest Sai Gayathri joins as contestants discuss personal growth and emotional openness.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil takes shelter at Meena's parental home and reveals his family woes. Determined, Meena decides to leave with him despite Pandian and Gomathi's strong objections.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Manoj accepts money from Rohini despite Vijaya's refusal. Meanwhile, family and friends visit Meena, who confides in Seetha and hopes Chandra visits too.
